{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Yer quite the ladies' man, ain't ye,
{{TAG:0011:0000:0100}}? I envies ya!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

ES:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}¡Qué tío! ¡Tú sí que sabes echar
las redes a las féminas, {{TAG:0011:0000:0100}}!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Eh beh, on peut dire que t'as la vie

{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Gar! Some guys have all the luck,

{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Arr! Bazı adamlarda bütün şans var,

{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Heh heh heh. Pretty popular with

{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Hé hé ! On dirait qu't'as pas mal de

{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Heh heh heh. Hanımlar arasında

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ye got yer mojo workin' today, eh,
{{TAG:0011:0000:0100}}? Good luck, me matey!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Bugün caziben yerinde, ha,
